## Strongest end-to-end claim

H6, SourceCurrentColdFiniteWarmCalls.constructed_node_calls, is unchanged.
For its covered closed constructions and valid initial constraint-allocation
history, any prescribed finite number of modeled node-processing rounds
has a complete actual trace at sufficient fuel and one mathematical width.
The final available value has exactly the initial finite-tree language.
The theorem uses the formal Formula and Entailment interfaces. It does not
establish full recursive typing or pruning, Haskell extraction, host integer
capacity, practical resource bounds or convergence.

## Current Context supplies the query resource producer

Existing GeneratedQueryFrameResources.complete retains a numeric forecast,
but it requires the joint query Frame. The recursive packet carries the
outer Context instead. Its Context does not imply that stronger Frame.

TargetQuery.finite_caller_resources closes this interface gap. Its inputs
are current Context, Fits profile, Room bits profile, and closed available
operands. Fits already includes Stored profile.mass for every stored payload.
There is no separate future trace, callback, range plan or cache premise.

Fits.room derives the exact current node, edge and domain admission bounds.
Closed availability in the coherent current heap derives both Original
facts. NativeComputedBudget.initial constructs one physical trace and its
actual value and complete checked state. Step.caller_post derives the full
existing target Receipt, exact next.source and next.roots equations and
outer Post at that endpoint. The Post retains all eight Context fields,
physical effects and both outer completed-memo extension histories.

Instruction-bound monotonicity raises the actual entry-counter bound to
the supplied profile bound. The finite trace completes at that computed
fuel plus one. Credit and causal-mass monotonicity bound the same returned
node, edge and domain counters and all stored payload masses. The returned
state satisfies Fits(step profile). The returned value has the same causal
mass bound. The theorem does not infer Room for a second query from Fits.

raw_done_caller_resources uses the same initial facts and one supplied raw
done observation. Exact completed-run uniqueness identifies its value and
EVERY checked-state field with the constructed witness. Its Receipt, Post,
Fits and result-mass bound therefore concern the actual supplied endpoint.
This is not a generic raw-success-to-checked-trace lift. The earlier width-2
counterexample and its precise limits remain unchanged.

## Preserve the captured packet and unused reservation

Recursive.query_complete is an initial-input producer. A current Packet,
Fits and Reserved bits profile(count + 1) construct one actual query. The
return retains the entire target Receipt and Post, the SAME captured cache
and metadata packet, Fits(step profile), and the original tail reservation.
The numeric producer uses Reserved.head. The retained budget uses tail.
The captured packet follows from actual Post, not from a frame-only safety
assumption. The caller has the literal returned checked state and retains
its original fourth and merge tables.

QueryHistory records a finite sequence of consecutive native target queries.
Each step contains current available and closed operands and an actual raw
execute.done result. The next query starts at advance of that exact returned
checked state. It retains the previous fourth and merge tables. It records
no callback or change to the enumeration cache or metadata.

query_history_resources takes the initial Packet, Fits and one reservation
for the recorded query count. Induction consumes head and tail and applies
raw_done_caller_resources at each actual endpoint. Posts compose in order.
The final caller retains the full Post, the SAME captured Packet and
Fits(advance profile count). No later Context, safety, cache or Room receipt
is an input. The recorded successful executions remain observation premises.
This theorem proves preservation. It does not produce the entire history.

query_history_reserved starts with Reserved bits profile(count + remaining).
It proves the same prefix result and retains Reserved at advance profile
count for every remaining query. advance_add aligns the suffix reservation.
No new numeric room is assumed at the returned endpoint.

## Integration boundary and next work

The actual recursive driver performs other effects between target queries.
Its query history has not been extracted into QueryHistory. That relation
also does not include allocation steps, enabled emptiness checks, changes
to full query memos, callback cache updates or recursive subtree completion.
Use existing concrete callback packet proofs for those cache changes. Keep
a separate resource forecast for each effect that changes the native state.

Next derive a costed observation for the actual terminal child and edge
execution. Retain the full Post and Packet at each literal returned state.
Combine those costs with callbacks and bounded recursive control. Derive
whole-subtree cost from the original input, then use the remaining original
reservation for the next sibling at the subtree's actual returned caller.
Do not substitute legacy Ranges: its sibling endpoints precede recursive
continuations. Do not describe a consecutive-query reservation as a complete
recursive-driver reservation. More fuel does not supply machine width.

Whole-driver language, terminal fallback, native Graph correspondence,
concrete solver correspondence, extraction and arbitrary lazy demand remain
open. Preserve per-output Posts at their own emission states as well as the
Post for the final native state. The full objective remains incomplete.
